Before: beef ~100g (~200 kcal), rice ~180g (~300 kcal), Greek salad ~150g (~150 kcal), fruit salad ~200g (~100 kcal), orange juice ~300ml (~135 kcal).

After: all beef eaten; about half the rice left (~90g eaten); salad mostly eaten except olives and feta (~110g eaten, ~80 kcal); fruit mostly eaten except watermelon (~130g eaten, ~70 kcal); juice about half drunk (~150ml, ~65 kcal).

Total eaten: 200 + 150 + 80 + 70 + 65 ≈ 565 kcal; mass ≈ 100 + 90 + 110 + 130 + 150 = 580 g.
